study.question: Observed limitation: g0-r0039-context_product uses context only after summing ten target-scored temporal blocks. Earlier ordinal/curvature changes improved their own parents (g0-r0013-block_task 0.66501112; g0-r0014-curvature_task 0.66560707), but cubic expansion failed to improve its duplicate control. Latest g0-r0047 target additions and all g0-r0048 partition changes remain below incumbent click AUC 0.668457307890924; these failures do not establish an information-recovery benefit. Can context-conditioned selection over the ten retained block contributions improve click AUC at unchanged learned capacity, and does its effect interact with auxiliary adapter-context transfer?
study.hypothesis: Task-specific context queries applied before temporal block collapse can select complementary target-conditioned history evidence that is unavailable to the incumbent global history projection. Reuse the existing rank-16 context projection and base-history projection columns, preserving all original base/tower and moment paths. Predict an advantage of selective over uniform pooling at fixed transfer setting. Test the interaction with the existing auxiliary adapter-context gradient gate; do not presume auxiliary transfer or attention must help.

nearest_work.difference: Archived v4 primary lines250-277 establish target-aware unnormalized pooling. Retain the inherited target scorer and its intensity-carrying base. New local contrast is a secondary context-conditioned readout over ten already-compressed block contributions, only inside the context/history correction.

Pinned benchmark lines129-187 and190-274 use fixed and feature-conditioned queries, explicit recent/earlier partitions, separate query/key/value/output weights and heterogeneous token mixing. We reuse existing per-task rank-16 projections over ten inherited blocks, add no query tokens or mixing stack, preserve original target pooling, and test a matched four-cell suite. This is a benchmark-source comparison, not an original HeMix reproduction or novelty claim.

Original link resolved but tools.py read reports detailed text unavailable. Original-method completeness and priority remain unverified. Only the explicitly labeled benchmark fallback and its pinned implementation were inspected.

Pinned forward113-145 pools sequence by target before tokenization and task-token interaction. We retain ten block contributions for one context readout inside an existing low-rank branch, without a heterogeneous Transformer or task tokens.

Cached section2.3 describes feature-conditioned query retrieval (HeMix/EST) and repeated interaction (OneTrans). Query retrieval is inherited prior art, not claimed novel. This is one readout, with unchanged history partition and no repeated sequence update.

inherited_components: Ten temporal blocks; uniform and feedback-stratified compression; attached rotated support with folded training and pruned evaluation
Five masked target-match/ordinal/curvature summaries and encoded match counts
All embeddings, frozen target/action visibility, target local activation and independent auxiliary scorer moment buffers
Task-specific residual adapters, context/history/output projection matrices, four Dice task towers, exact original learned initialization/order
Auxiliary source gates, detached primary-strata auxiliary population, unchanged training loss
study.proposed_difference: Preserve the existing per-block target-score-weighted value contributions before their existing sum; use no new inputs. Let c_j be a task block contribution (uniform for click; feedback-strata sum for auxiliaries), n_j its valid-event count, q=tanh(W_context context), k_j=tanh(W_history[:,:V](c_j/max(n_j,1))). Normalize q and k_j by their own RMS with epsilon1e-4, then score dot(q,k_j)/sqrt(rank). Softmax only over occupied blocks, explicitly yielding zero on an empty history. Multiply attention weights by occupied-block count M; retrieved_base=sum_j M*a_j*c_j, so equal scores reproduce the ordinary sum in real arithmetic and intensity is not converted to a mean. Only replace the first V base entries in the existing context/history correction input; preserve all five moment signals, match counts, residual adapter inputs and main base pooling. Uniform control computes the same retrieval arithmetic but selects the untouched original history tensor, providing exact structural parent bridges. Cross retrieval=context|uniform with the existing broad auxiliary adapter-context gradient block=False|True. Reuse projections and add no learned parameters, buffers, RNG, loss, BatchNorm call or host configuration.
predictions: Predeclared primary contrast: block_retrieval_transfer minus uniform_transfer validation click AUC >0. Secondary replication contrast: block_retrieval_blocked minus uniform_blocked >0. An unreplicated tiny difference is preliminary, especially after adaptive validation reuse.

Transfer interaction: (block_retrieval_transfer - block_retrieval_blocked) - (uniform_transfer - uniform_blocked). A positive value is evidence of interaction for the tested broad gate, not proof that retrieval alone transfers semantic knowledge.

All cells should have exactly the incumbent 32192421 parameters, identical parameter shapes and initial values, and no new state. Uniform_transfer should reproduce g0-r0039-context_product / g0-r0047-parent_replay (0.668457307890924); uniform_blocked should reproduce g0-r0039-context_product_blocked (0.6678548720585206), subject to host BF16 checks.

New zero interaction output matrices inherit initial parent prediction parity. With nonzero common weights, selective and uniform paths should diverge on suitable multiblock context examples but agree on empty and single-occupied-block histories within declared precision tolerance. Normalized gates sum to M; direct correction remains zero on empty histories.

Expect small additional rank-16 work and retained [B,10,3,V] block activations, not a free efficiency gain. Full validation all-task AUC/Logloss and history slices, GPU/train/wall/peak-memory/throughput/p50/p95 costs must be measured; no numerical cost improvement predicted.
falsifiers: If selective pooling does not exceed its matched uniform control, useful context-conditioned block selection is unsupported for that transfer setting; no automatic promotion based on auxiliary mean AUC.
If uniform bridges fail source/forward/backward/buffer/RNG checks or parent replay, withhold causal interpretation and diagnose numerical or implementation changes before charged follow-ups.
If advantage disappears under reserved seed or matched-compute comparisons, capacity is unchanged but useful robust complementarity remains unsupported.

If retrieval gate is essentially uniform or context perturbations do not change occupied-block weights at a common nonzero model state, the implementation has not tested effective conditional retrieval.

Any masked-history leakage, auxiliary item/action/scorer gradient leakage, target action access, nonfinite outputs/gradients or undeclared trainable state blocks host training; retain failure and costs.
alternative_explanations: Single frozen seed and adaptive validation reuse; deterministic replays are not independent repetitions
Retrieval changes optimizer trajectories and per-block competition; equal parameters do not mean equal measured cost
The existing broad adapter-context gate affects residual, fusion and retrieval context edges; it does not isolate retrieval-edge transfer
RMS scaling and count-preserving softmax are a coordinated retrieval design; success would not individually establish either choice

Adaptive rescaling by occupied block count, temperature/RMS geometry, altered per-block gradients, or auxiliary loss calibration could explain an improvement without recovering missing semantic information.
Four-task tradeoffs are material: incumbent auxiliary AUCs are about0.8079/0.8192/0.8309 versus DIN0.8491/0.8649/0.8702. Better click does not establish improvement for every task.
Historical positive and negative trajectories came from different model states; ordinal support and failed cubic/target/partition variants do not prove a universal compression theorem.

Review of latest_knowledge_usage: g0-r0048 declared DIN inheritance and consideration of OneTrans/Zenith/UniMixer, but the four executed partition cells all failed to beat the incumbent. Semantic versus interleaved click differences were +0.0001448714 (transfer) and +0.0001177140 (blocked); enabling broad transfer helped both (+0.0005300181/+0.0005028607). These are single-seed local implementation contrasts, not proof of the cited methods, new novelty, or independent repeated support. New records supersede no historical outcome; supplied evidence.jsonl and human/external sources remain untouched.
